GUARD_BLOCKED_ACTION: A Guard rule never allows this action, so it didn't run.
GUARD_ACTION_LIMIT: This action reached a Guard limit, so it didn't run.
GUARD_PII_BLOCKED: This request contains personal data that your organization's data filter blocks.
GUARD_CONTENT_BLOCKED: This content is blocked by a Guard content filter.
GUARD_RULE_NAME_TAKEN: Another rule already has this name. Choose a different one.
GUARD_RULE_LOCKED: An Owner locked this rule. Only Owners can change, turn off or delete it.
GUARD_RULE_TYPE_IMMUTABLE: A rule keeps its type. Add a new rule of the type you want.
GUARD_THRESHOLDS_INVALID: The AI double-check threshold must be lower than the automatic threshold.
GUARD_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason. It is recorded in the audit log.
GUARD_LOOSER_THAN_PARENT: This setting is looser than your organization's. Use the same or a stricter value.
GUARD_PII_RULE_NOT_FOUND: This data filter rule no longer exists.
GUARD_PII_RULE_DUPLICATE: This type already has a rule here. Change the existing rule instead.
GUARD_PII_PATTERN_INVALID: This pattern is too long, isn't a valid expression, or could run too slowly. Simplify it.
